== Notes ==

* This skill sets a single flight time and arc for standard arrows fired from any [[bow]]:
** All standard arrows travel at the same (faster) rate and fly nearly parallel to the ground.
{{anomaly|Some bow attack skills with a modified flight time or arc ignore the effect of Read the Wind on their flight time and arc but still benefit from the bonus damage, e.g. [[Broad Head Arrow]] and [[Called Shot]]. [[Quick Shot]] and [[Arcing Shot]] are exceptions to this.}}
* When used in conjunction with [[Favorable Winds]], the bonus damage stacks. Arrow arc and speed reduction only stack when Favorable Winds is applied last.
** Read the Wind is a slightly better choice for [[Flatbow]]s, since it lowers arc more, making it less likely that [[foe]]s will [[dodge]].
